sheets.prompt: Character design reference sheet for a science fiction exploration game: one hulk, a huge monster, drawn four times side by side at the same scale on a plain cream background: front view, side view, three-quarter view, and its attack wind-up with a long iron-bound club swung back over its shoulder in both hands. A small cloaked human traveller with a round jade backpack stands beside it for scale; the hulk is 2.7 metres tall, twice the traveller's width. Design: human proportions and joints, a hunched massive back, long heavy arms reaching to its knees, a small head with a jutting jaw, a single short horn on its brow and small eyes; smooth slate-blue skin with a pale belly, the base colour of its kind; a hide kilt and a rope belt; a long club. Slow and heavy. Original design, medium detail, a strong readable silhouette. Moebius science-fiction, Franco-Belgian ligne claire, fine pen contours, sparse delicate hatching in shadows, luminous flat pastel gouache colours, cream paper grain, evenly spaced views, fully visible bodies, no lettering. Avoid: photorealism, 3d render, text, lettering, labels, scenery, hollow knight, white mask, drapes, bandages, mummy, robes, gore.
